title: Live Oak: The Small Business Bank - [Business Breakdowns, EP.143]

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: Today we are breaking down Live Oak Bank.
reader_summary.overview: Today we are breaking down Live Oak Bank. Our guest is Stephen Vafier, the Founder of Storri Labs Capital Partners. Live Oak is a bank that received a charter right before the financial crisis. It does not have the a 100+ year histories of many of the banks that we know so well today, JP Morgan, Goldman Sachs.

key_points.text: It does not have the a 100+ year histories of many of the banks that we know so well today, JP Morgan, Goldman Sachs.
This is a new story with very interesting DNA in terms of how they built up this bank.
They targeted specific industries and the SBA loan program and they had technology in their inception.
